name: @acyka/python-sdk
description: Not published to npm — this is here so the root workspace can drive its checks.

scripts.check: sh -c 'PY=$(test -x .venv/bin/python && echo .venv/bin/python || echo python3); "$PY" -m pytest tests -q || { echo; echo "if that was a missing pytest: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install httpx pytest" >&2; exit 1; }'
